usdRate.sourceName: Maldives Monetary Authority, Table 1 Selected Economic Indicators: MVR per USD
usdRate.note: Managed peg at 15.42 per US dollar (2025 average 15.42).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Maldives Bureau of Statistics, CPI September 2026 release, year-on-year (all groups, Republic)
inflation_cpi.note: Also shown in MMA Table 1 (1.17%). Food and beverages +8.59%, tobacco -29.11% year-on-year.

inflation_projection.note: The rufiyaa is pegged to the US dollar and there is no inflation target, so we plan with a rounded 5-year average.

policy_rate.note: The MMA sets no single policy rate; its Standing Deposit Facility pays 0.25% and the Standing Lending Facility charges 7% (MMA Table 8, September 2026).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Maldives Monetary Authority, Table 8 Interest Rates: commercial bank saving deposits (MVR, weighted average)

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Maldives Monetary Authority, Table 8 Interest Rates: time deposits up to 3 months (MVR, weighted average)

fdr_1y_rate.note: MMA publishes time-deposit averages for up to 3 months (2.98%), 3-6 months (3.12%) and 2-3 years (5.44%), not 1 year. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring-deposit product or rate found. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals found. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Maldives Monetary Authority, Table 8 Interest Rates: 91-day Treasury bill
tbill_91d_rate.note: Bills are sold on tap at fixed rates (unchanged since 2015): 28-day 3.5%, 182-day 4.23%, 364-day 4.6%.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No published 5-year government bond yield found on MMA tables. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No published 10-year government bond yield found on MMA tables. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

tax_bank_interest.note: Maldives Inland Revenue Authority site returned HTTP 403 and PwC Tax Summaries has no Maldives page; tax treatment of deposit interest not confirmed. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists for this slot.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme found on MMA pages. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No published cap or typical card rate found. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

equity_return_low.note: The local stock exchange is tiny and illiquid, so the low case is below the safe rate.

equity_return_base.sourceName: 364-day T-bill 4.6%; global equity in US dollars (rufiyaa pegged to USD)
equity_return_base.note: Most equity exposure has to be global; with the peg we use a dollar equity return capped at the safe rate plus about 2.5 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: MASIX rose from about 197 (2020) to 490 (Sep 2026); global equity record
equity_return_high.note: A strong decade for global and local shares.

gold_return_low.note: With the peg, rufiyaa gold equals dollar gold, which can stall for a decade.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Long-run dollar gold trend; MVR pegged at 15.42 per USD
gold_return_base.note: No expected currency depreciation while the peg holds, so gold earns roughly the dollar gold trend.

gold_return_high.note: A strong gold decade or a devaluation of the rufiyaa.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: MMA: time deposits up to 3 months 2.98%

fixed_income_return_base.note: A mix of deposits and bills; tax on interest assumed nil pending confirmation.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry claim settlement ratio published by the MMA (insurance supervisor) found. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium guide or regulator data found. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published private hospital stay cost found; most care is financed by the Aasandha scheme. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium guide found. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

oop_health_share.note: Latest published figure is for 2023 (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices barely move because Aasandha covers most care; we plan with general inflation plus 1.5 points for private and overseas treatment.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: MBS CPI September 2026: education services +0.27% year-on-year
goal_inflation_education.note: Public schooling is free; we plan with general inflation plus 1.5 points for private and overseas study.

life_expectancy.note: Men 79.9, women 83.0. Latest published figure is for 2024 (older than 2025).

life_table_remaining.note: WHO GHO API was down (HTTP 500) and MBS publishes no life table on its site. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025: 6.5) and UN WPP 2024 medium variant via PopulationPyramid.net (2040: 15.4, 2065: 77.7)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+ = 100 / old-age dependency ratio; UN projects very fast ageing after 2040.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Maldives Pension Administration Office, Pension System leaflet: MRPS retirement pension age
retirement_age_default.note: Same for men and women, including anyone born after 1975; members who meet the conditions can draw a pension from 55.

retirement_age_government.note: No official statement of the civil service retirement age read. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: A balanced mix that earns little more than deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of equity base 7% and fixed income base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Roughly half equity and half safe fixed income over a working life.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: A growth-tilted mix in a good decade.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Maldives Pension Administration Office, Pension System leaflet: Old Age Basic Pension
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: MVR 5,000 a month since March 2019 for citizens aged 65+ (older than 2025: the leaflet is undated and no later change was found); reduced by other state pension income, so total pension income is at least MVR 5,000.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Maldives Pension Administration Office: Basic Pension
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: All Maldivian citizens aged 65+, under the Maldives Pension Act; not means-tested, but offset against other state pensions.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity rule found for private employees. Web search budget ran out during research; only official sites reachable by direct link were checked.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Maldives Pension Administration Office, Pension System leaflet: Maldives Retirement Pension Scheme (MRPS)
public_pension_scheme.note: Defined-contribution scheme: employer and employee each pay 7% of basic salary (14% in all); employees aged 16-65 and the self-employed can join. Pension from 65 (55 under conditions), paid as the account balance spread over 168 months (14 years); the basic pension tops low payouts up to MVR 5,000.

fdr_1y.note: Banks offer terms up to 3 years.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings certificate found.

tbill_91d.note: Bills are sold on tap at fixed rates, mainly to banks; no retail channel confirmed.

equity_fund.note: No local retail mutual fund confirmed; a few shares trade on the Maldives Stock Exchange (regulator: CMDA).

insuranceComplaints.name: Maldives Monetary Authority
insuranceComplaints.note: Complain to the insurer first, then to the MMA as supervisor.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Old Age Basic Pension (Maldives Pension Administration Office)

publicHealthCover.name: Aasandha universal health insurance (National Social Protection Agency)
